welcome.title: ¡WELCOME!
welcome.headline: ¡WELCOME!
welcome.message: YOU ARE IN CHARGE OF THE FIRST BASE ON MARS. YOU HAVE 28 DAYS TO BUILD THE COLONY AND KEEP YOUR CREW ALIVE. DO YOU ACCEPT THE MISSION?
welcome.story: YOU ARE IN CHARGE OF THE FIRST BASE ON MARS. YOU HAVE 28 DAYS TO BUILD THE COLONY AND KEEP YOUR CREW ALIVE. DO YOU ACCEPT THE MISSION?
welcome.hint: Choose your role, take care of oxygen, water, food, and energy, and guide your teammates across 28 Martian days.

scene1.tag: SCENE 1 OF 4: LAUNCH OF THE FUTURE
scene1.title: MARS-EF03 Habitat in Jezero Crater
scene1.text: Year 2038. CHAPEA-3 Mission. Four astronauts land on Mars with one goal: prove humans can survive 500 sols on the Red Planet.

scene2.title: Red Alert on the Cargo Module
scene2.text: Landing alert! A sudden dust storm damages the cargo pod, scattering vital supplies. The crew rushes inside the habitat.

scene3.title: Orbiting ESA Supply Capsule
scene3.text: Earth hears you, but help is far away. An orbiting ESA supply capsule will reach your base in 28 sols.

scene4.title: Khipu Mission Ledger Online
scene4.text: Every choice counts. Use the Khipu to balance power, water, crops, and radiation. Your challenge: survive all 28 sols.

step1.title: Step 1: Your 4 Vital Bars and the Khipu
step1.desc: At the top you see Oxygen, Energy, Food, and Water, and on the right the Inca Khipu. If any resource hits 0% or Radiation reaches 100%, the mission fails. Survive until Sol 28.

step2.title: Step 2: Your Astronaut and 3 Specialists
step2.desc: You control the main astronaut by tapping the Martian ground. Your 3 teammates (Engineer, Scientist, and Medic) work at exterior stations and join you when you perform tasks.

step3.title: Step 3: Real Physical Colony Tasks
step3.desc: Click CULTIVATE, BUILD, or EXPLORE below (or click any 3D building). Your astronaut will physically walk to the station and perform the job in real time before resources update.

step4.title: Step 4: Advance Sols and Overcome Storms
step4.desc: After completing your daily tasks, click the orange Next Day button at the top right. When a dust storm or leak alerts the base, choose how your crew resolves it.

taskProgress.working: Performing task at the station with the crew...
taskProgress.pcControlsHint: Click on the Martian ground or use WASD to walk your astronaut

roles.title: CHOOSE YOUR ROLE
roles.subtitle: SELECT SPECIALIZED CAREFULLY
roles.footer: Choose your specialty. Your role will determine how you help the crew survive on Mars.

commander.title: Commander
commander.desc: Lead the mission. Make final decisions when danger hits the colony.
commander.perk: Commander Perk: You save extra oxygen and energy when guiding the crew in emergencies.

engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.desc: Fix machines. Keep electricity, water pipes, and solar panels running.
engineer.perk: Engineer Perk: You use less scrap and gain bonus power when cleaning solar panels or fixing pipes.

medic.title: Medic
medic.desc: Care for the astronauts' health and shield them from solar radiation storms.
medic.perk: Medic Perk: You reduce radiation much faster and keep the whole crew strong and healthy.

scientist.title: Scientist
scientist.desc: Research Martian soil with the Rover and grow fresh food in the greenhouse.
scientist.perk: Scientist Perk: Your greenhouse crops grow faster and the Rover finds more water and metal.

khipu.title: KHIPU
khipu.subtitle: Andean Space Tracker
khipu.legend: Each glowing knot represents 20% of your colony reserves.

missions.step1: MISSION 1: First, we need food. Click the CULTIVATE button or the Greenhouse pin to water the plants.
missions.step2: MISSION 2: Well done! The plants grow food and clean air, but use water. Check the Solar Panels or Water Recycler.
missions.step3: MISSION 3: Walk your astronaut by tapping the ground or use EXPLORE to send the Rover for ice water.
missions.step4: MISSION 4: Keep Oxygen, Energy, and Food high until Day 28. When an alert appears, protect your crew!

npc.greetingScientist: Hi there! I am the Scientist. I am checking crater rock samples and tending our greenhouse plants.
npc.greetingEngineer: Hello! I am the Engineer. I am making sure red Martian dust does not block our solar panels.
npc.greetingMedic: Hi! I am the Medic. Remember to watch the radiation bar and keep the crew rested inside.

cultivateMenu.title: Space Greenhouse Crops
cultivateMenu.subtitle: Plants give us fresh food and clean oxygen to breathe

buildMenu.title: Build and Repair Colony
buildMenu.subtitle: Keep the base machines clean, sealed, and running safely

cleanPanels.title: CLEAN SOLAR PANELS
cleanPanels.bad: Uses -5 Scrap and a bit of Oxygen

exploreMenu.title: Explore Planet Mars
exploreMenu.subtitle: Search Jezero Crater with the Rover or walk to exterior stations

walkSolar.title: CHECK SOLAR PANELS
walkSolar.bad: Uses a little Oxygen while walking

eventA.title: ALERT: DUST STORM
eventA.subtitle: A giant red dust cloud blocks the Sun and covers the solar panels.
eventA.fact: On Mars, dust storms can last for weeks and block sunlight, affecting power generation.

opt1.title: DIVERT ENERGY
opt1.desc: Protects base air and heat, but greenhouse plants grow slower today.
opt1.feedback: You diverted electricity to keep the habitat warm and the crew safe.

opt2.title: CLEAN PANELS
opt2.desc: Go outside to sweep red dust off the solar panels and restore power.
opt2.feedback: You cleaned the solar panels! Colony power generation jumped back up.

opt3.title: WAIT INSIDE
opt3.desc: Everyone waits safely inside the habitat until the high winds pass.
opt3.feedback: The crew waited safely inside the base until the dust storm passed.

eventB.title: ALERT: WATER RECYCLER LEAK
eventB.subtitle: The red alarm beacon is blinking because a pipe is losing clean water.
eventB.fact: In space, astronauts recycle almost every drop of water so the colony never runs dry.

opt1.title: REPAIR NOW
opt1.desc: Seal the pipe with metal to recover all clean water.
opt1.feedback: You repaired the water recycler and turned off the red alarm beacon.

opt2.title: SAVE WATER MODE
opt2.desc: Stops the leak with zero energy cost, but plants get less water today.
opt2.feedback: You switched to water-saving mode and stopped the leak without spending power.

opt3.title: ROVER ICE SEARCH
opt3.desc: Send the Rover to the crater to bring fresh water ice.
opt3.feedback: The Rover returned from Jezero Crater with fresh water ice for the tanks.

eventC.title: ALERT: SOLAR STORM
eventC.subtitle: The Sun launched a wave of invisible radiation toward Mars.
eventC.fact: Because Mars has a thin atmosphere, astronauts must shelter inside when solar storms hit.

opt1.title: ENTER SHELTER
opt1.desc: Activate maximum habitat shielding to bring radiation down.
opt1.feedback: The whole crew entered the shielded shelter. Radiation dropped to safe levels.

opt2.title: PAUSE WALKS
opt2.desc: Nobody goes outside today to save oxygen and stay safe.
opt2.feedback: Outdoor walks were paused in time, saving oxygen and protecting the team.

opt3.title: KEEP WORKING
opt3.desc: Generates extra power outside, but increases radiation danger.
opt3.feedback: You generated extra electricity, but the crew's radiation level rose.

eventD.title: NOTICE: CLEANING WHIRLWIND
eventD.subtitle: A Martian dust devil whirlwind is passing near the base.
eventD.fact: Perseverance's microphone recorded Martian whirlwinds that can sweep dust off solar panels.

opt1.title: USE THE WIND
opt1.desc: Angle the solar panels so the wind sweeps the dust off for free.
opt1.feedback: The Martian wind swept the dust off the solar panels and boosted energy!

opt2.title: STUDY WITH ROVER
opt2.desc: Study the whirlwind and use the bonus energy to boost the greenhouse.
opt2.feedback: You studied the whirlwind and helped the greenhouse plants grow faster!

opt3.title: SAVE MOISTURE
opt3.desc: Close the greenhouse vents to trap extra clean water.
opt3.feedback: You sealed the greenhouse moisture vents and saved extra water.

guide.title: Quick Mission Guide
guide.touchRotate: Rotate camera: Drag with 1 finger or left mouse button.
guide.touchZoom: Zoom in or out: Pinch with 2 fingers or scroll the mouse wheel.
guide.touchTap: Move astronaut: Tap anywhere on the Martian ground or use the arrows to walk and greet your teammates.

tamboAlfa.title: Central Habitat and Greenhouse
tamboAlfa.subtitle: Where the astronauts live, grow plants, and control the colony.

solarEast.title: East Solar Panels
solarEast.subtitle: Capture sunlight to provide electricity for the entire base.

solarWest.title: West Solar Panels
solarWest.subtitle: Help charge the colony batteries during the Martian day.

marsRover.title: Perseverance Explorer Rover
marsRover.subtitle: Travels across Jezero Crater to find water ice and minerals.

waterRecycler.title: Water Recycler
waterRecycler.subtitle: Cleans and reuses water so the colony never runs out.

medaStation.title: Mars Weather Station
medaStation.subtitle: Measures wind speed, cold temperatures, and dust in the sky.

scienceNode1.title: Jezero Crater Center
scienceNode1.subtitle: Ancient Martian lakebed with water ice beneath the rocks.

scienceNode2.title: Ancient River Delta
scienceNode2.subtitle: Rocks rich in minerals and Martian history.

scienceNode3.title: Neretva River Channel
scienceNode3.subtitle: Great location to explore with the Rover.

scienceNode4.title: North Overlook Hill
scienceNode4.subtitle: High point for spotting approaching dust storms.

endScreens.winSummary: You survived all 28 days on Mars, tended the greenhouse, and kept your entire crew safe and healthy!
endScreens.loseHint: Always watch your Oxygen, Energy, and Water bars, and use your Role perk during storms.

defeat.water: The base ran out of water. Remember to fix the recycler and send the Rover for ice.
defeat.oxygen: Oxygen ran out. Take care of the greenhouse plants to produce fresh air.
defeat.energy: Batteries ran out of power. Remember to clean dust off the solar panels.
defeat.radiation: Radiation rose too high. Use the habitat shelter during solar storms.
